svg.title: AI-driven development with Claude Code, MCP and Copilot, plus six certifications
svg.desc: Control schematic: an agent loop (plan, code, test, human review) around Claude Code, connected over an MCP bus to the codebase, tools and data, with Copilot assisting the code step. Certifications shown as plain text inspection tags: Claude Code in Action, Introduction to Model Context Protocol and Claude 101 (Anthropic, Aug 2026); AZ-204 Azure Developer Associate, AI-900 and AZ-900 (Microsoft).
svg.text: Claude Code + MCP + Copilot, with tests and human review in the loop
